ABOUT

Messaging made human.

Welcome to a different kind of copywriting studio — where the words we write are rooted in research, crafted to connect, and driven by a deep care for you and your people.

Based in Portland, Oregon. Serving brands worldwide.

SEE SERVICES
WHETHER YOU’RE EXCITED TO LEVEL UP OR YOU FEEL YOUR BRAND HAS LOST ITS WAY...
You’re in the right place.

Because you and I both know true success isn’t built by hustling harder or being the loudest voice in the room, but by creating a meaningful, human connection with the clients you love to serve.

And that’s exactly why we’re here.

Hey, I’m Kelsey O’Halloran.
With research-based copy that reliably connects and converts, I help brands take the guesswork out of attracting the right clients.

Drawing on my background as a newspaper journalist, I’m here to guide you from confusion to clarity by uncovering your voice and learning to speak your clients’ language.

Together, we’ll cut through the noise and create a message that finally feels aligned.

SEE THE SERVICES
EXPLORE THE PORTFOLIO
Inspired by…
GREEN TEA
GOOD STORIES
GENTLE MOVEMENT
ALL THINGS HOME
Our work is guided by…

INCLUSIVITY

Black and brown lives matter. LGBTQ+ lives matter. Your voice deserves to be heard, and I'm here to listen, learn, and help you create words that honor all people.

HONESTY

Real stories build relationships. Together, we'll tell your story with truth and integrity, so you can resonate with the people you want to reach.

INTENTIONALITY

Every piece is crafted with purpose. From the words on your website to the process that guides us there, you’ll find deep support and strategy behind each step.

PARTNERSHIP

We're in this together. Long after our first collaboration, you can count on me for copywriting and content strategy support for your entire brand ecosystem.

“Kelsey captured the ‘feel’ of our business.”

Working with Kelsey exceeded any expectation — not only was she warm and attentive, but she was also patient and quick to understand who I am and my business. Our values, strengths, and “feel” were accurately captured in her work — I felt emotional (joy) when I read it. It was perfect!

FIONA ENKELMANN / NARAYANI WELLNESS
 
“She goes deep and is a great listener.”

Kelsey is empathetic by nature and thoughtful in how she interviews clients. She does research. She goes deep and is a great listener. She is a huge asset to anyone looking for assistance in a “voice” for their business. 

KAREN HOLLY / KH ESSENTIALS
 
“Working with Kelsey is like hanging out with your friend over coffee.”

She is the kindest, most intentional person who pays attention to detail, listens so well, and takes the time to pour into her clients and get to know them on a personal level to really bring their voices to life.

EMILY MAGERS / EMILY MAGERS PHOTOGRAPHY
MY PROMISE TO YOU
You’ll walk away with so much more than words.

It’s an honor to guide you to more aligned sales, renewed clarity and confidence in your brand, and a deeper connection with your clients at every touchpoint. Get started by scheduling your free consultation.

CONTACT KELSEY

Discover a simpler way to website copy that sounds like you, speaks to your people, and sparks genuine sales.
